title.narrative: Tripura Urban and Tourism Development Project

description.narrative:
The project will improve the Readiness of Integrated Urban Planning and Infrastructure Development for Urban Local Bodies in Tripura. The main outcome of the project would be: i. Integrated urban infrastructure planning and strategy of 7 DHQs and 13 ULBs leading to planned urban development and prioritization of investment projects. ii. Improved readiness of prioritized projects in 7 DHQs and key economic/border trade centers leading to increased external/donor investments in urban infrastructure projects. iii. Faster and more efficient development of urban infrastructure projects, better management of urban assets and better provision of urban services due to strengthened capacity of urban development agencies.
The key activities to be carried out as part of the project would be: i. Urban strategy/investment planning of 7 DHQs and 13 ULBs and project prioritization in sectors including urban transport, connectivity among urban centers, electrical connectivity, drinking water, sewerage, septage etc. ii. Feasibility studies, DPRs, detailed engineering designs, safeguards, bidding documents and project preparation support to improve readiness. iii. TA support for institutional strengthening of urban development department and support in PRF activities including developing ToRs for consultants and quality control of PRF outputs.
The key output of the project would be: i. Urban strategy and investment plans for integrated urban infrastructure development of 7 DHQs and 13 ULBs completed. ii. Ensuing urban investment projects in 7 DHQs and identified key economic and border trade centers prioritized. iii. Timely completion of feasibility reports, DPRs and other project preparation activities for prioritized urban infrastructure projects. iv. Strengthened capacity of urban development department to plan, design, develop and manage infrastructure assets for the for the proposed 7 DHQs and 13 ULBs.

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Output 1 Indicator: Feasibility study, detailed engineering designs, and due diligence of priority subprojects completed. Output 2 will be achieved by (i) undertaking necessary feasibility studies and detailed engineering design tasks for the preparation of detailed project reports; (ii) conducting due diligence to cover the technical, economic, financial, environmental and social safeguard, gender, impact of coronavirus disease (COVID-19), and climate change and disaster risk aspects of the priority subprojects; and (iii) undertaking a strategic procurement planning study and a project procurement risk assessment to identify contract packaging, contract modalities, procurement plans, and bid documents; and supporting the bidding process. Progress/Status: Feasibility for both phases has been finalized. DPR for phase I is finalized, for phase II , the reports are under preparation. For tourism, phase I, DPR and feasibility reports have been finalized. For phase II, new components have been identified.

Output: Output 1 Indicator: Institutional capacity developed. Output 3 will be delivered by (i) carrying out an institutional and organizational review to determine the project pre-implementation capacity building activities for the executing and implementing agencies of the ensuing projects in areas such as safeguards, procurement, gender, financial management, and contract management; (ii) establishing institutional mechanisms and processes for undertaking investment-ready infrastructure projects; (iii) reviewing institutional capacities and operation and maintenance practices; and (iv) outlining requisite reform actions and the scope of the institutional strengthening component for the ensuing projects to ensure the sustainability of assets. Progress/Status: The draft Institutional Review Report and institutional strengthening and capacity development report has been submitted by the EA and finalized. Few capacity building programs have been conducted and will continue until the loan availability period.

Output: Output 1 Indicator: Sector strategy and investment plans prepared. Output 1 will be delivered through (i) supporting improved urban infrastructure plans by preparing and/or strengthening urban strategy and investment plans for integrated development of infrastructure in 7 DHTs and 13 ULBs; (ii) supporting tourism policy by preparing and/or strengthening tourism strategy and development plans for tourism destinations; (iii) developing a prioritization matrix with multiple indicators and a decision-enabling lens to assess and prioritize the urban areas and tourism products, and investment components; and (iv) phasing investments in prioritized urban areas and tourism products for the ensuing subprojects. Progress/Status: Under the Urban component of the project, the report on Urban Strategy and Investment Plans, Prioritization Framework/ Subproject Selection Criteria was submitted by EA, which was reviewed by ADB and the EA has finalized the reports.
Under the Tourism component of the project, the report on Tourism Market Analysis and Investment Need Assessment, Tourism Strategy, Action and Investment Plan, and Prioritization Framework/ Subproject Selection were submitted by EA, which was reviewed by ADB and the EA has finalized the reports.
